rule: Body-less member declarations of scanned types are defined in the scan (high): a call that resolves to a method declared without a body by a trait, interface, protocol, abstract class or pure-virtual C++ declaration (`fn now() -> u64;`, `virtual void OnError() = 0;`, `def m: Int`, an interface method) is high when that declaring type is in the scan, exactly as Go interface calls are. | A type variable resolves to its declared bound (C++: a concept that pins one type, `std::same_as<T>` / `derived_from<T>`; otherwise unconstrained, stays low). | C1 ... A definition that edges reach is listed in `nodes`, including body-less member declarations of scanned types (interface/trait/protocol methods)
notes: IRepo.Save (interface method) and Shape.Area (abstract) have no bodies but their declaring types are in the scan: high, and both IDs must be in nodes (C1). repo is a field of declared type IRepo. In SaveAll, r's type T is bounded by IRepo: IRepo#Save. In Show, T is unconstrained, so value.ToString() stays a low guess `value.ToString`.
